title: 并发复习路线、运行支持与版本边界

blocks.text: 并发程序的关键，是让多个执行者在正确的时间观察、修改和移交同一份状态，并在失败时收回资源。理解一个方案，至少要说清共享状态、不变量、同步关系、容量上限和结束协议；选一个 API 只是最后一步。
本书以 Java 21 为教学基线，沿着内存模型、同步器、任务调度、容器、工程诊断和完整编程题展开。涉及 JDK 8、17、24、25 的地方单独说明版本。示例都在本书正文中完整列出，同名源文件便于复制和独立运行。它们展示局部协议及受控测试，不代表生产性能数据。
建议先读每节第一段，练习用一分钟解释结论；再读机制和反例，最后合上答案实现编程题。复习 Java 基础时关注对象、泛型和集合契约，复习 JVM 时关注执行与内存管理；本书重点解决它们在多线程访问下如何协作。
这册可以怎样复习
先确定共享状态和成功条件，再选择锁、原子类或任务编排工具。把线程池看成有容量、有拒绝、有结束协议的系统，更容易把参数题和实际排错连起来。
第一轮：先说清并发正确性

items: 1 先把并发问题说清楚 → 2 线程生命周期和合作取消 → 3 JMM 可见性与安全发布 → 4 synchronized 显式锁与 AQS
7 线程池从任务接收到容量预算

blocks.text: 先能解释原子性、可见性、顺序和合作取消的区别，再口述线程池提交时核心线程、队列、最大线程数与拒绝的先后。首轮先与操作系统的线程、切换、阻塞衔接，AQS和实现代码留在同一知识线继续加深。
第二轮：沿过载和依赖失败推导机制

items: 7 线程池从任务接收到容量预算 → 8 任务失败 取消和优雅关闭 → 9 Future CompletableFuture 和任务依赖 → 13 死锁 饥饿与现场诊断
10 ThreadLocal 上下文与 Spring 异步边界 → 12 虚拟线程与两层资源预算

blocks.text: 从“所有任务共用一个池”这个简单方案出发，逐次增加慢下游、长队列、任务互相等待和取消条件。用到达速率、等待时间、下游容量和内存解释线程与队列预算；再说明异常如何被看见、个人超时为何不能污染共享结果、虚拟线程为何仍需两层准入。
第三轮：把协议写出来并制造失败

items: 15 生产者消费者与可关闭队列 → 16 手写有界线程池
19 把并发协议放进真实系统设计 → 20 用 NoteWeave 解释线程池隔离与上下文

blocks.text: 用有界队列和线程池检查提交、交接、close、取消、唤醒与终止确认。再演练慢任务隔离、上下文恢复和旧回调竞争，观察队列、拒绝、线程栈与真正完成速率；没有监视器死锁，也可能因池内依赖而饥饿。
怎样算学会了
每个回答先说保护的对象与不变量，再讲一次状态变化和一个反例。同步工具、CAS、并发容器、顺序打印、LRU及原生语言对照仍完整保留，按需要回查并完成对应实现。

sections.title: Lambda、record 与模式匹配的并发边界

blocks.text: Lambda record 和模式匹配怎样关联并发
Lambda 是以函数式接口为目标类型的行为值，本身不会启动线程；到底在哪执行取决于谁调用它。常见运行时实现涉及 invokedynamic 链接及 LambdaMetafactory，但不承诺每次必定创建新对象或总复用同一对象。捕获局部变量要求 final 或 effectively final，只限制该局部引用重新赋值，不冻结它指向的 List。
record 的组件字段是 final，仍只是浅层不可变；把可变 List 放进 record 后发布，列表元素和结构仍可变化。用于并发快照时应在构造边界防御复制并约束元素。Java 21 正式引入 record patterns 和 switch 模式匹配，record 与 instanceof 模式并非首次出现于 21；不能把后续版本的基本类型模式或 21 的预览特性混进无需预览的代码。
模式 switch 要考虑支配顺序、穷尽性和 null。具体模式应放在覆盖它的宽泛模式之前，when 表达额外守卫，case null 显式处理空输入。record 解构会调用访问器，访问器异常和独立二进制演进都可能引出匹配失败，不能把它当成永远无异常的字段语法糖。完整语言规则可结合 Java 基础册复习，本书使用它们表达不可变任务结果和明确状态。

sections.title: 完整辅助类、运行器与面试自检

blocks.text: 运行器的失败报告边界：本节 run_labs.py 展示了一种不完整的报告实现，不能据其 lab-report.json 全部 exit_code=0 推断整轮成功。timeout 或启动异常发生在追加记录之前，可能留下旧轮成功报告；版本与输出断言失败也可能只留下成功前缀。subprocess.run 超时回收直接子进程，不保证所有后代退出。需要完整失败记录时，应采用本页“实验运行器：报告与清理边界”中的实现，并遵守其中的进程清理限制。
22 运行练习与面试自检
完整代码怎样运行
本书 Java 练习使用 Java 21，不开启预览、不连接真实服务，也不依赖第三方库。先解压整个文件夹，再运行 python3 scripts/run_labs.py；脚本直接调用 JDK 编译模块，所以即使 javac 不在 PATH，只要完整 JDK 的 java 可用仍可编译。
默认运行所有 Java 主入口和 LRU 命令行样例。已有 C++20 编译器及 Node.js 时加 --cpp-js；已有 Go 1.21 或更高工具链时加 --go 运行原生 Go 的 race 检测测试。脚本不会安装工具或下载依赖。Go、Lua 与 Spring 配置的语言及运行环境不同，不能拿 Java 编译成功替它们声称验证完成。
sliding_window.lua 是供明确 Redis 部署环境集成的完整脚本，本地教学运行器不启动 Redis。NoteWeave 配置文本需要对应 Spring/MDC 依赖与项目上下文，单独保存便于阅读，不加入无依赖 Java 练习的编译集合。
公共测试辅助类如下。测试内等待有上界，故意不合作的任务都有拥有者控制的退出开关；其中统计时间只是便于发现卡住，不是性能基准。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile and run controlled local examples. No services, downloads or package installation."""
import argparse
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
JAVA_LABS = [
    "PublicationLab", "SnapshotDemo", "LockLab", "AtomicsLab", "PoolLifecycleLab",
    "AsyncWorkflowLab", "SharedTimeoutDemo", "CallerRunsContextDemo", "ContextBindingsLab",
    "CollectionsLab", "DateTimeLab", "ForkJoinLab", "ThreadPhasesLab", "VirtualBudgetDemo",
    "PermitDependencyDemo", "OrderingLab", "MonitorDeadlockLab", "CloseableRing",
    "ConditionQueue", "ProducerConsumerLab", "TwoStackQueue", "BoundedPool", "LruCache",
    "TtlLruCache", "OwnershipLab", "RetryLab", "DualDetectionLab", "SlidingWindowLimiter",
    "InclusiveAlternatorTest",
]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--build", type=Path, default=ROOT / "build")
    parser.add_argument("--cpp-js", action="store_true", help="also require and run C++20 and Node.js")
    parser.add_argument("--go", action="store_true", help="also require Go 1.21+ and run its race-enabled tests")
    options = parser.parse_args()
    build = options.build.resolve()
    build.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    report = []

    def run(label, command, timeout=40, cwd=ROOT, input_text=None, env=None):
        started = time.monotonic()
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, input=input_text, text=True,
                                capture_output=True, timeout=timeout, env=env)
        report.append({"label": label, "command": command, "exit_code": result.returncode,
                       "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
                       "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr})
        (build / "lab-report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
        if result.returncode:
            sys.stderr.write(result.stdout + result.stderr)
            raise RuntimeError(f"{label} failed with {result.returncode}")
        print(f"OK {label}")
        return result

    java = shutil.which("java")
    if not java:
        raise RuntimeError("Java 21 JDK required")
    version = run("java-version", [java, "-version"])
    match = re.search(r'version "(\d+)', version.stdout + version.stderr)
    if not match or match.group(1) != "21":
        raise RuntimeError("Use a Java 21 JDK for this pinned teaching baseline")
    sources = [str(path) for path in sorted((ROOT / "code").glob("*.java"))]
    run("compile-java", [java, "-m", "jdk.compiler/com.sun.tools.javac.Main", "-source", "21", "-target", "21",
                         "-encoding", "UTF-8", "-d", str(build), *sources], timeout=90)
    for name in JAVA_LABS:
        run(name, [java, "-cp", str(build), name])
    cli = run("LruCli", [java, "-cp", str(build), "LruCli"],
              input_text="2\nPUT a one\nPUT b two\nGET a\nPUT c three\nGET b\nEVICT 9\n")
    if cli.stdout != "one\nNULL\n2\n":
        raise AssertionError("LruCli output mismatch")
    if options.cpp_js:
        compiler, node = shutil.which("g++"), shutil.which("node")
        if not compiler or not node:
            raise RuntimeError("--cpp-js requires an existing C++20 compiler and Node.js")
        run("cpp-version", [compiler, "--version"])
        run("compile-cpp", [compiler, "-std=c++20", "-pthread", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Wpedantic",
                            str(ROOT / "code/native_cpp.cpp"), "-o", str(build / "native_cpp")], timeout=90)
        run("native_cpp", [str(build / "native_cpp")])
        run("node-version", [node, "--version"])
        run("native_js", [node, str(ROOT / "code/native_js.mjs")])
    if options.go:
        go = shutil.which("go")
        if not go:
            raise RuntimeError("Go compiler missing; no installation will be attempted")
        version = run("go-version", [go, "version"])
        if not version.stdout.startswith("go version go"):
            raise RuntimeError("the command named go is not the Go language toolchain")
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.update({"GOCACHE": str(build / "go-cache"), "GOMODCACHE": str(build / "go-mod-cache"),
                    "GOPROXY": "off", "GOTOOLCHAIN": "local"})
        run("native_go", [go, "test", "-race", "-count=1", "-timeout=30s", "./..."],
            cwd=ROOT / "code/go", env=env, timeout=120)
    print(f"Completed {len(report)} controlled commands. Timings are not performance benchmarks.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

blocks.text: 最后用五个问题检验自己的答案
能解释共享状态与不变量，才算理解方案；能解释容量与结束协议，才算把它放进工程。

items: 哪些状态由谁拥有？锁身份、原子根、线程绑定和资源租约是否稳定？
哪个动作原子？哪条 happens-before 保证读取结果？复合操作是不是只做了一半同步？
任务数、字节数、连接、速率和费用分别怎样限制？队列满时调用者能否明确知道失败？
中断、超时、拒绝、回调异常、关闭和重试时，谁负责唤醒同伴并回收真正拥有的资源？
版本前提是什么？哪些是语言/API 契约，哪些只是当前 OpenJDK 或框架实现？怎样用受控交错而非碰运气验证？

blocks.text: 先合上正文回答一个具体问题，例如“count++ 改成 volatile 为什么还是不够”。可以先说结论：“volatile 能保证相关可见性和顺序，但 count++ 仍会丢更新。我会用同一锁包住读改写，或用 AtomicInteger。”随后用两个线程读到同一个旧值的交错解释原因，再补原子边界和使用条件。
接着只改一个条件：“如果这是高争用统计，而不是库存硬限额呢？”这时可以评估 LongAdder，但不能直接用它的并发 sum 判断硬限额。若这一问卡住，就回到原子类章节核对 sum 的契约，再脱离正文解释一次。复习要留下的是能处理条件变化的答案，以及还没有弄清的具体问题；不需要把整章从头机械背一遍。

sections.title: 线程池启动异常安全：实现与测试

blocks.text: BoundedPoolTeaching 的启动流程强调异常安全。先创建并登记全部 Thread，再逐个预留 alive 并启动；仅 start 尚未成功的异常由构造线程撤销预留，启动成功后的计数由 worker finally 唯一负责。启动后的测试钩子失败进入外层 shutdownNow，不进入预留回滚。固定数组避免 start 后 ArrayList 扩容失败。构造失败发出停止请求，不宣称返回时已 join；测试显式等待并 join 验证真实退出。

测试缝 Startup 仅包内使用：start 必须正常启动，或在真正启动前抛出；不支持启动后又抛异常的恶意自定义 start。生产构造器使用普通 Thread.start。真实 VM 崩溃、不可恢复的资源耗尽、interrupt 自身失败不在恢复承诺内。任务忽略中断仍可能永不终止；shutdownNow 返回只代表请求停止，不代表任务清理完成。生产优先使用 ThreadPoolExecutor。
定向测试使用受控 Error 注入注册前、第二个 worker 启动前（已有一个成功启动）、第一个 worker 成功启动后失败；验证原异常、拒绝提交、alive 恰好归零、实际线程退出，并复用饱和拒绝、优雅排空、立即停止、任务异常隔离和中断状态复位测试。不触发真实 OOM。

sections.title: 实验运行器：报告与清理边界

blocks.text: run_labs_corrected.py 在先决条件检查前写入带唯一 run_id、outcome=running 的整轮报告；每条命令先登记，再在 finally 记录超时、启动异常、输出及清理结果。顶层记录版本检查、输出断言等流程失败，只有整个流程正常完成才写 passed。该运行器把手写线程池测试切换到 BoundedPoolStartupTest，其余原始实验保留；已验证的范围仅包括定向回归测试，不包含其他实验的完整运行。
报告用同目录临时文件与原子替换，要求受支持的本地文件系统。不同并发运行必须用不同 build 目录。磁盘/权限导致初始化或最终写入失败会抛异常，可能保留上一次完整快照；必须核对本轮 run_id、进程退出状态及终态 passed，不能只读一个旧 JSON。强制杀死或断电可留下 running，不能视作成功。

POSIX 子进程创建新会话，超时及普通退出后都对该进程组请求 TERM/KILL，并限时 wait 直接子进程；报告明确 descendant_exit_verified=false。后代若 setsid/setpgid 逃离组不在清理范围，非 POSIX 仅处理直接子进程。发送信号并不证明全部后代已退出或被回收，进程创建时间也未必受 timeout 严格限制。文件捕获避免后代持有管道导致 communicate 等待；报告截断输出，但临时磁盘写入量没有硬上限，只运行审核过的本地受控示例。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Corrected teaching runner; the frozen source/scripts/run_labs.py is unchanged.

Each invocation replaces the report BEFORE prerequisite checks. Writes use atomic
rename, so readers see a complete snapshot, not a partially written JSON file.
A hard kill/power loss may leave outcome=running: that is explicitly NOT success.
Use a distinct --build directory per concurrent invocation (no shared-run locking).

POSIX commands start a new session; timeout AND normal completion trigger bounded
TERM/KILL cleanup of that process group. Descendants that escape via setsid/setpgid
are outside this guarantee. On other platforms only the direct child is managed.
Process creation itself is not covered by the wait timeout and may take longer.
File-backed capture avoids hanging on inherited stdout/stderr pipes. Output in the
report is capped, but temporary capture disk usage is not: trusted local labs only.
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import json
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import uuid

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "source"
DEFAULT_BUILD = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "build"
CAPTURE_LIMIT = 1024 * 1024


def atomic_json(path, value):
    # Same-directory replacement is atomic on supported local filesystems.
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".lab-report-", dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as output:
            json.dump(value, output, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
            output.write("\n")
            output.flush()
            os.fsync(output.fileno())
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        if os.path.exists(temporary):
            os.unlink(temporary)


class TeachingRunner:
    def __init__(self, build, cleanup_grace=0.2):
        self.build = Path(build).resolve()
        self.build.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.path = self.build / "lab-report.json"
        self.cleanup_grace = cleanup_grace
        self.report = {"schema_version": 2, "runner": "corrected-teaching",
                       "run_id": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                       "started_at": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                       "outcome": "running", "commands": [], "error": None,
                       "cleanup_scope": "POSIX process group; escaped descendants excluded"
                       if os.name == "posix" else "direct child only"}
        self.save()

    def save(self):
        atomic_json(self.path, self.report)

    def finish(self, outcome, error=None):
        self.report.update(outcome=outcome, error=error,
                           finished_at=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
        self.save()

    def cleanup(self, process):
        result = {"scope": self.report["cleanup_scope"], "errors": []}
        if os.name == "posix":
            for signum in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGKILL):
                try:
                    os.killpg(process.pid, signum)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    break
                except OSError as error:
                    result["errors"].append(str(error))
                if signum == signal.SIGTERM:
                    time.sleep(self.cleanup_grace)
        elif process.poll() is None:
            try:
                process.kill()
            except OSError as error:
                result["errors"].append(str(error))
        try:
            process.wait(timeout=self.cleanup_grace)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            result["errors"].append("direct child did not exit within cleanup bound")
        result["direct_child_reaped"] = process.returncode is not None
        # Signals requested are not evidence that every descendant has exited.
        result["descendant_exit_verified"] = False
        return result

    def run(self, label, command, timeout=40, cwd=ROOT, input_text=None, env=None):
        command = [str(part) for part in command]
        started = time.monotonic()
        row = {"label": label, "command": command, "status": "running",
               "exit_code": None, "timeout_seconds": timeout, "stdout": "", "stderr": ""}
        self.report["commands"].append(row)
        self.save()
        process = None
        failure = None
        with tempfile.TemporaryFile() as output, tempfile.TemporaryFile() as errors, tempfile.TemporaryFile() as input_file:
            if input_text is not None:
                input_file.write(input_text.encode("utf-8"))
                input_file.seek(0)
            try:
                process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=cwd, stdin=input_file,
                                           stdout=output, stderr=errors, env=env,
                                           start_new_session=(os.name == "posix"))
                process.wait(timeout=timeout)
                row["status"] = "passed" if process.returncode == 0 else "failed"
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
                row["status"] = "timeout"
                failure = error
            except OSError as error:
                row["status"] = "launch_error" if process is None else "execution_error"
                failure = error
            except BaseException as error:
                row["status"] = "interrupted"
                failure = error
            finally:
                if process is not None:
                    row["cleanup"] = self.cleanup(process)
                    row["exit_code"] = process.returncode
                    if row["cleanup"]["errors"] and failure is None:
                        row["status"] = "cleanup_error"
                        failure = RuntimeError("bounded process cleanup failed")
                for key, stream in (("stdout", output), ("stderr", errors)):
                    stream.seek(0)
                    data = stream.read(CAPTURE_LIMIT + 1)
                    row[key] = data[:CAPTURE_LIMIT].decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                    row[key + "_truncated"] = len(data) > CAPTURE_LIMIT
                row["elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)
                if failure is not None:
                    row["error"] = {"type": type(failure).__name__, "message": str(failure)}
                self.save()
        if failure is not None:
            raise failure
        if row["status"] != "passed":
            raise RuntimeError(f"{label} failed with {row['exit_code']}")
        print(f"OK {label}")
        return subprocess.CompletedProcess(command, row["exit_code"], row["stdout"], row["stderr"])

JAVA_LABS = [
    "PublicationLab", "SnapshotDemo", "LockLab", "AtomicsLab", "PoolLifecycleLab",
    "AsyncWorkflowLab", "SharedTimeoutDemo", "CallerRunsContextDemo", "ContextBindingsLab",
    "CollectionsLab", "DateTimeLab", "ForkJoinLab", "ThreadPhasesLab", "VirtualBudgetDemo",
    "PermitDependencyDemo", "OrderingLab", "MonitorDeadlockLab", "CloseableRing",
    "ConditionQueue", "ProducerConsumerLab", "TwoStackQueue", "BoundedPoolStartupTest", "LruCache",
    "TtlLruCache", "OwnershipLab", "RetryLab", "DualDetectionLab", "SlidingWindowLimiter",
    "InclusiveAlternatorTest",
]


def run_suite(runner, options):
    build = runner.build
    run = runner.run
    java = shutil.which("java")
    if not java:
        raise RuntimeError("Java 21 JDK required")
    version = run("java-version", [java, "-version"])
    match = re.search(r'version "(\d+)', version.stdout + version.stderr)
    if not match or match.group(1) != "21":
        raise RuntimeError("Use a Java 21 JDK for this pinned teaching baseline")
    sources = [str(path) for path in sorted((ROOT / "code").glob("*.java"))]
    teaching = ROOT.parent / "teaching"
    sources.extend([str(teaching / "code/BoundedPoolTeaching.java"),
                    str(teaching / "tests/BoundedPoolStartupTest.java")])
    run("compile-java", [java, "-m", "jdk.compiler/com.sun.tools.javac.Main", "-source", "21", "-target", "21",
                         "-encoding", "UTF-8", "-d", str(build), *sources], timeout=90)
    for name in JAVA_LABS:
        run(name, [java, "-cp", str(build), name])
    cli = run("LruCli", [java, "-cp", str(build), "LruCli"],
              input_text="2\nPUT a one\nPUT b two\nGET a\nPUT c three\nGET b\nEVICT 9\n")
    if cli.stdout != "one\nNULL\n2\n":
        raise AssertionError("LruCli output mismatch")
    if options.cpp_js:
        compiler, node = shutil.which("g++"), shutil.which("node")
        if not compiler or not node:
            raise RuntimeError("--cpp-js requires an existing C++20 compiler and Node.js")
        run("cpp-version", [compiler, "--version"])
        run("compile-cpp", [compiler, "-std=c++20", "-pthread", "-O2", "-Wall", "-Wextra", "-Wpedantic",
                            str(ROOT / "code/native_cpp.cpp"), "-o", str(build / "native_cpp")], timeout=90)
        run("native_cpp", [str(build / "native_cpp")])
        run("node-version", [node, "--version"])
        run("native_js", [node, str(ROOT / "code/native_js.mjs")])
    if options.go:
        go = shutil.which("go")
        if not go:
            raise RuntimeError("Go compiler missing; no installation will be attempted")
        version = run("go-version", [go, "version"])
        if not version.stdout.startswith("go version go"):
            raise RuntimeError("the command named go is not the Go language toolchain")
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.update({"GOCACHE": str(build / "go-cache"), "GOMODCACHE": str(build / "go-mod-cache"),
                    "GOPROXY": "off", "GOTOOLCHAIN": "local"})
        run("native_go", [go, "test", "-race", "-count=1", "-timeout=30s", "./..."],
            cwd=ROOT / "code/go", env=env, timeout=120)


def main(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--build", type=Path, default=DEFAULT_BUILD)
    parser.add_argument("--cpp-js", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--go", action="store_true")
    options = parser.parse_args(argv)
    runner = TeachingRunner(options.build)
    try:
        run_suite(runner, options)
    except BaseException as error:
        runner.finish("interrupted" if isinstance(error, (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit)) else "failed",
                      {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)})
        raise
    else:
        runner.finish("passed")
        print(f"Completed {len(runner.report['commands'])} controlled commands. Timings are not performance benchmarks.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Local, dependency-free regression tests; never invokes Java or the full lab suite."""
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
from unittest import mock

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts/run_labs_corrected.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('teaching_runner', SCRIPT)
runner_module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(runner_module)


class ReportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.directory = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.directory.cleanup)
        self.build = Path(self.directory.name)
        self.path = self.build / 'lab-report.json'
        self.path.write_text('{"outcome":"passed","run_id":"old"}')

    def read(self):
        return json.loads(self.path.read_text())

    def invoke(self, action):
        with mock.patch.object(runner_module, 'run_suite', side_effect=action):
            return runner_module.main(['--build', str(self.build)])

    def test_prerequisite_failure_replaces_stale_success(self):
        with mock.patch.object(runner_module.shutil, 'which', return_value=None):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, 'Java 21'):
                runner_module.main(['--build', str(self.build)])
        report = self.read()
        self.assertEqual(report['outcome'], 'failed')
        self.assertNotEqual(report['run_id'], 'old')
        self.assertEqual(report['commands'], [])
        self.assertEqual(report['error']['type'], 'RuntimeError')

    def test_initialized_before_checks(self):
        def action(runner, options):
            self.assertEqual(self.read()['outcome'], 'running')
            self.assertEqual(self.read()['commands'], [])
            self.assertNotEqual(self.read()['run_id'], 'old')
        self.invoke(action)
        self.assertEqual(self.read()['outcome'], 'passed')

    def test_wrong_java_version_is_final_failure(self):
        real_run = runner_module.TeachingRunner.run
        def fixture_run(runner, label, command, **kwargs):
            self.assertEqual(label, 'java-version')
            return real_run(runner, label, [sys.executable, '-c',
                            'import sys; print(\'openjdk version "17.0.1"\', file=sys.stderr)'], **kwargs)
        with mock.patch.object(runner_module.shutil, 'which', return_value=sys.executable):
            with mock.patch.object(runner_module.TeachingRunner, 'run', fixture_run):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(RuntimeError, 'Java 21'):
                    runner_module.main(['--build', str(self.build)])
        report = self.read()
        self.assertEqual(report['commands'][0]['status'], 'passed')
        self.assertEqual(report['outcome'], 'failed')
        self.assertIn('Java 21', report['error']['message'])

    def test_output_assertion_failure_overrides_successful_command(self):
        def action(runner, options):
            result = runner.run('output-check', [sys.executable, '-c', 'print("wrong")'])
            if result.stdout != 'expected\n':
                raise AssertionError('fixture output mismatch')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError, 'output mismatch'):
            self.invoke(action)
        report = self.read()
        self.assertEqual(report['commands'][0]['status'], 'passed')
        self.assertEqual(report['outcome'], 'failed')
        self.assertEqual(report['error']['type'], 'AssertionError')

    def test_launch_failure_is_recorded(self):
        def action(runner, options):
            runner.run('missing', [str(self.build / 'does-not-exist')])
        with self.assertRaises(FileNotFoundError):
            self.invoke(action)
        report = self.read()
        self.assertEqual(report['outcome'], 'failed')
        self.assertEqual(report['commands'][0]['status'], 'launch_error')
        self.assertEqual(report['commands'][0]['error']['type'], 'FileNotFoundError')

    def test_nonzero_exit_records_output(self):
        def action(runner, options):
            runner.run('failure', [sys.executable, '-c', 'import sys; print("seen"); sys.exit(7)'])
        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            self.invoke(action)
        row = self.read()['commands'][0]
        self.assertEqual(row['exit_code'], 7)
        self.assertEqual(row['status'], 'failed')
        self.assertEqual(row['stdout'], 'seen\n')
        self.assertEqual(self.read()['outcome'], 'failed')

    def test_timeout_records_output_and_reaps_child(self):
        def action(runner, options):
            runner.run('timeout', [sys.executable, '-c', 'import time; print("started", flush=True); time.sleep(60)'], timeout=0.5)
        start = time.monotonic()
        with self.assertRaises(subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
            self.invoke(action)
        self.assertLess(time.monotonic() - start, 5)
        row = self.read()['commands'][0]
        self.assertEqual(row['status'], 'timeout')
        self.assertIn('started', row['stdout'])
        self.assertTrue(row['cleanup']['direct_child_reaped'])
        self.assertFalse(row['cleanup']['descendant_exit_verified'])
        self.assertEqual(self.read()['outcome'], 'failed')

    def test_success_and_input(self):
        def action(runner, options):
            result = runner.run('echo', [sys.executable, '-c', 'import sys; print(sys.stdin.read(), end="")'], input_text='hello\n')
            self.assertEqual(result.stdout, 'hello\n')
        self.invoke(action)
        self.assertEqual(self.read()['outcome'], 'passed')
        self.assertEqual(self.read()['commands'][0]['status'], 'passed')

    def test_atomic_replace_failure_preserves_last_complete_snapshot(self):
        before = self.path.read_text()
        with mock.patch.object(runner_module.os, 'replace', side_effect=OSError('simulated disk failure')):
            with self.assertRaises(OSError):
                runner_module.atomic_json(self.path, {'outcome': 'running'})
        self.assertEqual(self.path.read_text(), before)
        self.assertEqual(list(self.build.glob('.lab-report-*')), [])
        # Failure to initialize propagates; the runner never executes commands.
        with mock.patch.object(runner_module, 'atomic_json', side_effect=OSError('disk failure')):
            with mock.patch.object(runner_module, 'run_suite') as suite:
                with self.assertRaises(OSError):
                    runner_module.main(['--build', str(self.build)])
                suite.assert_not_called()

    @unittest.skipUnless(os.name == 'posix' and Path('/proc').exists(), 'Linux process-state inspection')
    def test_normal_exit_cleans_remaining_group_child(self):
        pidfile = self.build / 'child.pid'
        # Child announces readiness before its parent exits, avoiding a spawn race.
        child = 'import os,signal,time,pathlib; signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIG_IGN); pathlib.Path(' + repr(str(pidfile)) + ').write_text(str(os.getpid())); time.sleep(60)'
        parent = 'import subprocess,sys,time,pathlib; subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,"-c",' + repr(child) + ']); p=pathlib.Path(' + repr(str(pidfile)) + '); deadline=time.monotonic()+5\nwhile not p.exists():\n if time.monotonic()>deadline: raise RuntimeError("child readiness timeout")\n time.sleep(.01)\n'
        pid = None
        try:
            self.invoke(lambda runner, options: runner.run('descendant', [sys.executable, '-c', parent], timeout=8))
            pid = int(pidfile.read_text())
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 3
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                stat = Path(f'/proc/{pid}/stat')
                if not stat.exists() or stat.read_text().split(') ')[1].startswith('Z'):
                    break
                time.sleep(.01)
            else:
                self.fail('in-group descendant remained running')
            self.assertFalse(self.read()['commands'][0]['cleanup']['descendant_exit_verified'])
        finally:
            if pid is None and pidfile.exists():
                pid = int(pidfile.read_text())
            if pid:
                try:
                    os.kill(pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                except ProcessLookupError:
                    pass


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
